name: Mike Altier
title: VP, Product Design
quote: I had the privilege of recruiting and managing Ji-Sook for several years, and during that time, she proved herself to be an extraordinary design leader, the kind who raises the bar for everyone around her. She is the first person I think of when the most complex business needs or design challenges arise. She researches deeply and designs the conditions that make great work possible. Her ability to build and scale design culture created lasting impact well beyond her immediate team.
